compendium.summary: An expanded-source concentration hazard whose strongest researched use is coordinated containment. The spell and its partner require separate concentration holders.
warnings: Source-sensitive: availability does not grant permission by itself; use the exact selectable entry and campaign rules.
The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Agree on the active Xanathar's spell and how its exhaustion effects interact with the campaign's 2024 rules. Do not import an old exhaustion penalty table into a revised game.
In the Wall of Force pairing, cast the hazard first, then have another caster contain the targets. Placing a spell through an already sealed barrier is not a safe assumption.
Keep both casters protected and plan for teleportation, Disintegrate, concentration loss, immunity and successful saves. This is a conditional setup, not a guaranteed boss kill.
